pairs.question: What is the return window for purchases?
pairs.ground_truth: All purchases come with a 14-day return window.

pairs.question: How long does it take to process a refund?
pairs.ground_truth: Refunds are processed within 5 business days of receiving the returned item.

pairs.question: Are digital products refundable?
pairs.ground_truth: Digital products are non-refundable once downloaded.

pairs.question: What condition must items be in for a refund?
pairs.ground_truth: Items must be in original condition to qualify for a refund.

pairs.question: How many days can employees work remotely per week?
pairs.ground_truth: Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week with manager approval.

pairs.question: How far in advance must remote work be requested?
pairs.ground_truth: Remote work requests must be submitted 48 hours in advance.

pairs.question: What are the core hours for remote workers?
pairs.ground_truth: Employees must be available during core hours of 10am to 3pm in their local timezone.

pairs.question: What must be used when accessing company systems remotely?
pairs.ground_truth: VPN must be used when accessing company systems remotely.

pairs.question: How many paid leave days do full-time employees get?
pairs.ground_truth: Full-time employees receive 20 days of paid leave per year.

pairs.question: How far in advance must long leave be approved?
pairs.ground_truth: Leave must be approved at least 2 weeks in advance for periods longer than 3 days.

pairs.question: How many unused leave days can be carried over?
pairs.ground_truth: Unused leave can be carried over up to a maximum of 10 days.

pairs.question: What is the expense limit for direct manager approval?
pairs.ground_truth: Business expenses up to 500 USD can be approved by direct managers.

pairs.question: Who approves expenses above 500 USD?
pairs.ground_truth: Expenses above 500 USD require VP approval.

pairs.question: Within how many days must expenses be submitted?
pairs.ground_truth: All expenses must be submitted within 30 days of incurrence with receipts.

pairs.question: Do travel expenses need pre-approval?
pairs.ground_truth: Travel expenses require pre-approval before booking.

pairs.question: What is the minimum password length required?
pairs.ground_truth: All employees must use strong passwords of at least 12 characters.

pairs.question: Is two-factor authentication mandatory?
pairs.ground_truth: Two-factor authentication is mandatory for all company accounts.

pairs.question: Can sensitive data be stored on personal devices?
pairs.ground_truth: Sensitive data must not be stored on personal devices.

pairs.question: How quickly must security incidents be reported?
pairs.ground_truth: Security incidents must be reported to IT within 1 hour of discovery.

pairs.question: What is the refund policy for ACME Corporation?
pairs.ground_truth: ACME offers a 14-day return window with refunds processed within 5 business days. Items must be in original condition. Digital products are non-refundable once downloaded.
